headline: Public hearing on zoning variance requests for 20 Canal Street and 48 Buckmeadow Road, the latter postponed to 12/8/2026.
summary: The meeting will consider two variance requests for properties on Canal Street and Buckmeadow Road. The Buckmeadow Road request has been postponed to 12/8/2026.
items: Variance requests for 48 Buckmeadow Road, postponed per applicant to 12/8/2026: minimum land area, open space, more than one principal structure on a lot, and cumulative driveway width
Variance request for 20 Canal Street for minimum land area for 6 dwellings
Review of upcoming agenda to determine proposals of regional impact
location: 3rd floor auditorium, Nashua City Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH

ZONING BOARD OF ADJUSTMENT 
October 27, 2026 
 
AMENDED AGENDA 
 
 
The following is to be published on ROP October 18, 2026 under 
the Seal of the City of Nashua, Public Notice Format 65 MP 51. 
Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing of the City of Nashua 
Zoning Board of Adjustment will occur on Tuesday, October 27, 
2026, at 6:30 p.m. in the 3 rd floor auditorium at Nashua City 
Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH. Members of the public can submit 
their comments via email to (zb@nashuanh.gov) or by mail (please 
make sure to include your name/address and comments) by 4:00 p.m. 
on October 26, 2026. Letters should be addressed to City of 
Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. 
Plans can be viewed online starting October 20 , 2 026, at 
www.nashuanh.gov. 
 
1. Miguel Bisono (Owner & Applicant) 48 Buckmeadow Road (sheet 
C Lot 216) requesting the following variances from Land Use 
Code Section 190-16, Table 16-3: 1) for minimum land area, 
67,949 sq.  ft existing – 160,000 sq. ft required for 4 
dwellings, 2) for minimum open space, 75% required, 66% 
proposed; 3) from Land Use Code Section 190 -17,B for more 
than 1 principle structure on a lot – 4 proposed; 4) from 
Land Use Code Section 190 -17,E for cumu lative driveway 
width, 24 feet permitted – 41 feet proposed across 2 
driveways. R40 Zone, Ward 5.  
[POSTPONED PER APPLICANT TO 12/8/2026] 
 
2. Anand Mahendrakar (Applicant) Blue Coral Canal LLC (Owner) 
20 Canal Street (Sheet 42 Lot 72) requesting variance from 
Land Use Code Section 190 -16, Table 16-3 for minimum land 
area, 10,308 sq. ft existing – 52,272 Sq. ft required for 6 
dwellings.  LB Zone, Ward 3.
